title: Born for me, Born to die

slides.label: Verse 1
lines: I’m so grateful for the life
You’ve given me
I have all that’s true and holy Lord
You have set me upon
Your throne divine
All because the Christ was born for me

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: Born for me, Born to die
Christ the Lord was born for me
A savior like no other
Christ, God’s love in victory

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: Christmas only tells the story of His birth
For He lived to die to save the world
He arose from death to give us life
And forever we will live with Him

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: Born for me, Born to die
Christ the Lord was born for me
A Savior like no other
Christ, God’s love in victory

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: What a joy this Christmas is to me
With His love divine in full display
Who on earth would ever live for you
Yet forevermore He lives for us

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: Born for me, Born to die
Christ the Lord was born for me
A Savior like no other
Christ, God’s love in victory
